(Legislative Department) NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 2nd May, 2025 S.O. 1999(E).— In pursuance of section 67 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 (43 of 1951), the following declaration containing the name of the candidate elected to fill the seat in the Council of States from the State of Andhra Pradesh that fell vacant on 25th January, 2025 by reason of resignation of Sri Venumbaka Vijaya Sai Reddy, before the expiration of his term of office which was up to and including 21st June, 2028, is published for general information:– Declaration Bye-Election to the Council of States by the elected members of the Legislative Assembly of Andhra Pradesh. “In pursuance of the provisions contained in sub-section (2) of section 53 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, read with sub-rule (1) of Rule 11 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, I declare that SRI PAKA VENKATA SATYANARAYANA H.No. 26-8-17/1, Pamarthyvari Veedi, Balusumudi, Bhimavaram, West Godavari District, Andhra Pradesh – 534201. [Sponsored by BHARATIYA JANATA PARTY (name of the recognised political party)] has been duly elected to fill the vacancy caused in that House by the resignation of Sri Venumbaka Vijaya Sai Reddy on 25.01.2025. A.P. Assembly Buildings, Velagapudi, Guntur – 522238. Date: 02-05-2025 Sd/- Returning Officer” [F. No. H.11024/03/2025-Leg.II] Dr. RAJIV MANI, Secy.
